scripts.name: Setup Worktree
scripts.command: vp i && ln -sf $T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/.env .env && ln -sf $T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/infra/relay/.env infra/relay/.env && node apps/web/scripts/warm-dep-cache.ts

scripts.name: Setup Worktree (Windows)
scripts.command: vp i && New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink -Path .env -Target "$env:T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT\.env" -Force && New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink -Path "infra\relay\.env" -Target "$env:T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT\infra\relay\.env" -Force && node apps\web\scripts\warm-dep-cache.ts

scripts.name: Build Intel package (macOS)
scripts.command: mise exec node@24.13.1 -- node scripts/lastcode-build-intel-package.ts run
